Work

Role: Video Editor

Highlights

GambiCast & GambiDay

RoleContent Coordinator

Built around gambiarra, the Brazilian art of finding creative solutions with available resources, these projects helped marketing professionals use technology and AI to gain more autonomy.

For GambiCast, I developed the production process from scripting and visual direction to filming, editing, and animation. The show grew from zero to over 20K views across two seasons.

For GambiDay, a two-day hybrid event with eight-hour live broadcasts, I led audiovisual preparation and the first edition’s live production, then supervised the second. I also coordinated campaign videos and sketches. The event launched GambiAcademy, the company’s learning platform for technology, no-code, and Artificial intelligence.

KondZilla Video Manifesto

RoleFull Post-Production

KondZilla is Brazil’s largest YouTube channel, known for funk music videos. Its portfolio also includes productions for streaming platforms, such as Sintonia, the most-watched series on Netflix in 2019, and advertising campaigns for brands such as Coca-Cola, Adidas, and Nubank.

Starting with the voice-over narration, I built the film’s visual story by curating existing footage. Drawing on my in-depth knowledge of the brand, I brought the script to life without the need for additional filming.

The film serves as a strategic brand positioning asset in meetings with major streaming platforms and CEO presentations, including international events such as Web Summit 2022 in Portugal.

Short Film: A Dream from the Outskirts

RoleDirector of Photography & Colorist

Part of a three-film project by Vivência.Lab exploring fashion and culture in Brazilian favelas, O Sonho Periférico connects material desires with dreams of progress and belonging.

I was responsible for cinematography and color grading, creating a soft, desaturated, dreamlike look. My work also included visual direction, camera operation, location scouting, budgeting, and shooting schedules.

The project received coverage in major Brazilian media outlets, including Folha de S.Paulo, Estadão, and FFW, and was supported by the São Paulo Department of Culture.

Sketch Program: Raxaria

RoleVideo Editor

Raxaria was a comedy show created by one of KondZilla’s directors. It started on the Portal KondZilla YouTube channel before moving to its own channel, which grew to over 500K subscribers.

I edited comedy sketches, using storytelling and comedic timing to keep audiences engaged. The format also helped KondZilla’s early TikTok growth in 2021, with videos reaching over 4 million views.

I later applied this approach to social media content, paid media, and brand awareness campaigns, including projects that mixed entertainment with branded content.

RD Summit Riddles Campaign

RoleContent Coordinator

A lead generation campaign for RD Summit, Brazil’s largest marketing event, using riddles and prizes to build brand awareness through gamification.

After the success of the first edition, we created a more elaborate campaign. I helped develop the video concepts and scripts and led audiovisual production for comedy sketches about participants’ obsession with the game.

We also created “Glaze,” a video that used the buzz around the Blaze controversy in Brazil at the time, linking the topic to a guessing game about RD Summit’s surprise musical act.

Career Mentorship Campaign

RoleContent Coordinator

Mentoria de Carreira is a career-development product built from scratch with key stakeholders and launched through three campaigns over one year.

I helped develop the content concept and strategy, combining livestreams, social media, paid media, and inbound marketing in campaigns lasting two to three months.

Two of the three campaigns achieved over 10x ROAS, delivering the company’s best B2C results to date. The program also helped over 200 clients advance their careers through raises, promotions, and new job opportunities.

How ElevenLabs Scaled to US$600 Million in ARR

RoleAI Content Producer

A business case study about ElevenLabs, produced with AI tools to make editing faster.

I created a custom AI skill to review footage, remove mistakes, select the best takes, and build a first cut based on the script. I also used AI to develop and create animations, find relevant visual inserts, and add them to the edit.

AI helped me complete a 10-minute video in around eight hours instead of the two days it would normally take, while I remained responsible for creative decisions and the final edit.
